name: Bellevue
beschreibung: The Gasthof Bellevue is a traditional inn in Tirol. It offers overnight accommodation as well as a dining room with regional cuisine. The rooms are simply and comfortably furnished. The inn is located away from the main roads in a quiet setting. From here, guests can take guided hikes. In summer, the beer garden invites you to linger. The inn is a starting point for tours into the surrounding mountains. The reception is not staffed at all times; arrival by prior arrangement is required.
